requirements: Add parseDependencies(entries) to src/deps.js. entries are backlog entries built by src/entries.js, features and quick wins mixed, with unique titles. Any entry, feature or quick win, may end a line of its text with a Requires clause: `**Requires:** none.` or `**Requires:**` followed by a comma-separated list of entry titles and a period; titles never contain commas. Return a map from each entry's title to the titles it requires, and a problem message for every required title that names no entry.

defects.consequence: requiresOf reads only entry.body, which quick wins do not have, so every quick win's Requires clause is silently treated as none and its unknown dependencies are never reported.
defects.origin: Ready silently ignores dependency lines on quick wins

defects.consequence: The unknown-dependency message repeats the entry's own title where the missing title belongs, so it never says which dependency is unknown.

decoys.consequence: A dependency on an entry listed later in entries is reported as unknown.
decoys.evidence: src/deps.js:16 the unknown check runs before later entries are seen
decoys.reason: titles is built from every entry before the loop starts, so a later entry's title is already known.
